## Appearance

Diana possesses striking black eyes paired with glossy, jet-black tresses of hair. Her complexion is further characterized by her rosy cheeks.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P22](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0022), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P10](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0010)_

## Personality

Diana is a good, smart, and ladylike girl who approaches situations practically. She possesses talent as a singer, capable of performing solos, and holds a reputation for her notable taste in dressing.

## History

Diana Barry was named by a schoolmaster who boarded with her family when she was born. After meeting [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope), Diana quickly became her close companion, with the pair solemnly swearing eternal friendship. Though her mother briefly forbade her from playing with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), Diana rushed to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for help when her sister [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) fell ill with severe croup, restoring their friendship after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) saved the child's life. Diana actively participated in childhood pastimes alongside [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), including performing in a successful school concert, founding a story club on their way to school, and attending a hotel charity concert. Later, Diana enthusiastically brought [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) the news that she had tied for first place on the Island's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examinations, and she reconnected with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) upon her return home from commencement at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P64](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0064), [v1 CHAPTER XII. ## Quotes

> "I’m awfully glad you’ve come to live at Green Gables. It will be jolly to have somebody to play with. There isn’t any other girl who lives near enough to play with, and I’ve no sisters big enough."
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P27](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0027)

> “Yes,” said Diana, tossing her head, “but I’m sure he doesn’t like Julia Bell so very much. I’ve heard him say he studied the multiplication table by her freckles.”
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P19](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0019)

> “Those Pye girls are cheats all round,” said Diana indignantly, as they climbed the fence of the main road. “Gertie Pye actually went and put her milk bottle in my place in the brook yesterday. Did you ever? I don’t speak to her now.”
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026)

> “I don’t believe he’ll find the doctor at Carmody,” sobbed Diana. “I know that Dr. Blair went to town and I guess Dr. Spencer would go too. Young Mary Joe never saw anybody with croup and Mrs. Lynde is away. Oh, Anne!”
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P24](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0024)

> “Everything went off very well,” said Diana practically. “I guess we must have made as much as ten dollars. Mind you, Mr. Allan is going to send an account of it to the Charlottetown papers.”
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves P49](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0049)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--diana-barry.md)

Diana and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) become fast, devoted friends upon their first meeting in the garden at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope), solemnly swearing eternal friendship. Their bond survives an enforced separation by Diana's mother, which ends after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) successfully saves Diana's sister [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) from croup. Diana stands by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) through school events, illness, and local social gatherings, maintaining a close emotional connection as they grow up.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P8](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P27](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0027), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), +35 more_

### [Barry](../character/barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/barry--diana-barry.md)

Mr. [Barry](../character/barry.md) is Diana's father, who resides at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope). He assists the girls when needed, such as carrying [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) home after she breaks her ankle at a party hosted at his house.

### [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana-barry--jane-andrews.md)
